company_facts: Arthrex describes itself as a leader in new product development and medical education in orthopedics (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Rep-Education-Operations-Analyst-Intern-FL-34108/1373884257/)

Internship runs January-April 2027 in Naples, FL, 20-30 hours/week, supporting the Rep Education team (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Rep-Education-Operations-Analyst-Intern-FL-34108/1373884257/)

Benefits for 20+ hours/week include medical insurance, EAP, onsite clinics and lunch, 8 volunteer PTO hours, wellness center access (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Rep-Education-Operations-Analyst-Intern-FL-34108/1373884257/)
mission_and_values: Tagline: 'Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better' (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Rep-Education-Operations-Analyst-Intern-FL-34108/1373884257/)
Medical education is a core part of the business, which this team supports (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Rep-Education-Operations-Analyst-Intern-FL-34108/1373884257/)
technical_topics: instructor request workflows: tracking and documentation
Excel (formulas, pivot tables, lookups, cleaning data)
Outlook, Word and PowerPoint for coordination and reporting
ordering supplies and workbooks, calendar management
scoping and delivering an operational improvement project
SQL or scripting to check data quality (a plus from the student's background)
hr_topics: time management across multiple small tasks
written and verbal communication with instructors and internal teams
interest in medical education and operations
